tools.name: browse_categories
tools.description: List free3d.io catalog categories, optionally filtered by keyword. Returns ids and urls; pass an id to open_category to navigate. Site-wide keyword search is not available server-side, so browsing categories is the entry point into the catalog.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter category names, e.g. chair, kitchen, door

tools.name: get_model_public_card
tools.description: Fetch public JSON metadata for a model by 8-character hash (no download URL).

tools.name: get_site_policy
tools.description: Return the machine-readable LLM agent policy and x402 payment instructions for free3d.io.

tools.name: get_x402_pricing
tools.description: Fetch x402 pricing.json with accepted networks, tokens, and API key plans.

tools.name: open_category
tools.description: Navigate to a category page by numeric category id.

category_id.description: Category id from sitemap or card metadata
